name: CSV inventory
description: Assets from a spreadsheet saved as CSV: name, IP, type, system, role, VLAN, criticality
author: Solid Geeks

file.label: Import a CSV file
file.help: One asset per line, with a header line. Columns (any order, any case): name (required), ip, type, os, role, vlan (number or name), criticality (1 to 3, or low, medium, high), notes. Separated by commas, semicolons or tabs, as your spreadsheet saves it.

fields.label: Update the assets already on the map (same name or IP)
